comment: Header profiles for spikes/csp-style-injection, read by the spikes/csp-navigation hosts. 'strict' is Spar's base policy (plan section 3b) with Trusted Types; 'nonce' adds a per-response nonce to style-src only. {NONCE} is replaced per response and given to HTML pages as <meta property="csp-nonce" nonce="…">.
base: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'

nonce.csp: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'nonce-{NONCE}'; img-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; connect-src 'self'; worker-src 'self'; manifest-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'; object-src 'none'; require-trusted-types-for 'script'
